items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: had a very good captain on our base, Captain C.W. King... He was a good man.

ctx.x: We had real gentleman-like people that we worked around in the Navy formation, people that were actually in public life, respected people and people that weren't so much Army, Navy, as down-to-earth people, had a very good captain on our base, Captain C.W. King. Before he got in the service, he was connected with the Coca-Cola Bottling Company and things like that. He was a good man. It was a nice tour of duty.
Sounds good. So you went into the Navy from Hampton's band?
